data.one_liner: Dart client for Amazon SNS API, generated from AWS SDK spec.
data.what_it_does: Provides a type‑safe, generated interface to Amazon Simple Notification Service. It wraps all SNS REST endpoints and handles request signing and serialization.
use_when: You need to publish or subscribe to SNS topics from a Flutter app
You want full coverage of the SNS API without writing boilerplate
You prefer a generated client that stays in sync with AWS changes
avoid_when: You only need simple push notifications and prefer a lightweight solution
You are building a non‑AWS backend and want a generic HTTP client
weaknesses: No built‑in retry or back‑off logic
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, provide AWS credentials via shared_aws_api, no build_runner needed
